name: PageHeader
summary: A page title and description with optional back navigation and primary actions.

props.name: title / description
props.meaning: The page h1 and concise supporting text.

props.name: back / actions
props.meaning: Caller-owned navigation and action controls. No routing or mutation is performed by this component.

accessibility: Provides the page's h1. The caller supplies real links and buttons with accessible names; actions stay in reading order when the layout stacks.
usage: Use once below the application shell. Keep routing in the caller and provide Button controls for actions. Back navigation appears above the title.

examples.label: Settings page header
examples.description: A synthetic page heading with a local demonstration action.
